title: Mummified pharaohs in the Cairo museum with cranial deformation, looking like gray aliens

tellings.quote: national museum in Cairo and you see some of these mummified you know pharaohs they look very short. They clearly they've engaged in some sort of cranial deformation to mimic the gods and they look like gray aliens.

plain: On an episode about the pyramids with a guest named Luke Caverns, podcast host Jesse Michels says that some of the mummified pharaohs (ancient Egyptian kings) in the national museum in Cairo look very short. He says they clearly reshaped their skulls on purpose to look like the gods. To him they resemble gray aliens, the small, big-headed beings described in many alien encounter stories, and if that is true it would suggest the ancient Egyptians were imitating beings like that.
